Name: JP's Starter Buildings - Starter Farm Animals - Farm Buildings
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][center][color=#00ff00][size=6][b][i][u]Starter Buildings[/u][/i][/b][/size][/color][/center]


[color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]Because there's nothing better on an abandoned farm than abandoned animals and buildings in perfect condition, right?[/i][/b][/size][/color]



[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]This mod allows you to choose the buildings you want to start your game with, as well as the animals you want (or don't want) on your farm! It also works in saved games and on custom maps.[/size][/font]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]You can choose to place Barns, Coops (up to 10 each), and Silos (up to 5). At the start of the day, their locations will be chosen at random, provided there are free spaces without obstacles where they can be placed. You will be notified by a message that the buildings have been placed. If there is no space available, you will be notified and must clear the area of obstacles so that the buildings can be placed again the following day. [/size][/font]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]As for animals, you can place any of the available ones in the quantities you want. If there is no space available in the buildings, you will be notified and it will wait until the next day to try to place them again. You can set the maximum number of animals (up to 12) yourself. Buildings will start at level 1, and upgrading them will affect the number of mod animals that can be placed.[/size][/font]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][b][color=#ff0000]Mod animals will only be created in Mod buildings.[/color][/b][/size][/font]
[/list][color=#ff0000][size=3][b]
[/b][/size][/color][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]There is also an option to place animals randomly; you just need to make sure you have enough space for the buildings. [/size][/font]
[/list][size=3]

[/size][size=3][b]There's not much else to say, buildings are placed randomly on the map in areas without obstacles, so you can end up with some very strange locations. Space is guaranteed above and below buildings to avoid blockages, and they will not appear near warp points on the maps for the same reason. It works on [color=#00ffff]custom maps.[/color][/b][/size]


[b][i][color=#00ff00][size=5]That's it, GMCM is very necessary in this mod in order to configure the mod according to your preferences. You will find detailed information in each option. [/size][/color][/i][/b]


[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.
